Perfect! All gates pass. Here's a summary of the implementation:

## Personal API Tokens Feature

I've successfully implemented a complete personal API tokens system for the Guren app that allows users to create, manage, and use API tokens for JSON API access.

### Key Components Implemented:

**Database & Models:**
- Added `api_tokens` table to store token hashes (not plain-text)
- Created `ApiToken` model with userId, name, and tokenHash fields

**Token Management Routes:**
- `POST /profile/tokens` - Creates named API tokens, returns token once (1-50 char names)
- `DELETE /profile/tokens/:id` - Revokes tokens (user can only revoke their own)

**JSON API Routes:**
- `GET /api/posts` - Lists all posts (id, title, excerpt, authorId, createdAt)
- `POST /api/posts` - Creates posts; author set to token owner regardless of request body

**Authentication & Security:**
- Bearer token authentication via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- SHA-256 hashing for token storage (plain-text never stored)
- Token validation middleware that requires valid bearer tokens for API access
- Returns 401 Unauthorized for invalid/revoked/missing tokens

**Rate Limiting:**
- 60 requests per minute per token (not per user, so each token gets its own limit)
- Returns 429 Too Many Requests with `Retry-After` header when exceeded

**Comprehensive Testing:**
- 18 test cases covering token creation, deletion, validation, API access, and edge cases
- All tests pass with proper database cleanup between tests

**Code Quality:**
- TypeScript typecheck passes
- guren check passes (route validation, consistency)
- guren gate passes (all CI stages: codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, test)
